quarterly_data.signal: Data center copper interconnect, 2025 (annual report): building on whole-system and core-component cooperation with leading domestic cloud service providers, the company focused on overseas markets, with notable business-development results in North America; several core component products gained recognition from mainstream overseas cloud service providers and compute-equipment makers, and several key products were delivered. It provided core high-speed interconnect support for the ETH-X supernode, and its self-developed 224G KOOLIO CPC/NPC solution, 224G Intrepid NEXUS backplane connector and Intrepid Cable Cartridge high-speed cable backplane solution are in commercial use in some mainstream AI clusters in China and abroad. Its data center range covers Intrepid high-speed backplanes, CPC & NPC, external interconnect (DAC/ACC/Lite Active Cable) and internal interconnect (high-speed internal cables, SSIO, riser cables).
quarterly_data.figure: 224G KOOLIO CPC/NPC, 224G Intrepid NEXUS backplane connector and Intrepid Cable Cartridge in commercial use in AI clusters

quarterly_data.signal: Optical interconnect, 2025 (annual report): the company launched LRO and LPO optical modules on a 'light active' concept; 800G/1.6T optical modules are in small-batch supply, 800G LRO has passed validation at some customers, and 1.6T LRO/LPO and XPO products are in deep pre-research (its DPO/LPO/LRO modules and AOCs support up to 1.6T). For next-generation 102.4T-class data centers it is running simulation and test validation of a 448G copper product matrix (448G KOOLIO CPC with Optamax high-speed bare wire, 1.6T AEC/ACC, OSFP-XD PCIe 6.0 AEC), has launched an XPO ultra-high-density interconnect solution with 12.8Tbps per module (built-in liquid cold plate up to 400W), and is accelerating 1.6T LRO/LPO and 3.2T NPO in R&D, which it calls a bridge before CPO reaches full commercial use.
quarterly_data.figure: 800G/1.6T optical modules in small-batch supply; 800G LRO passed some customers' validation; XPO 12.8Tbps per module

quarterly_data.signal: Data center power and thermal, 2025 (annual report): for the ORV3 power architecture the company offers Busbar, Powershelf and Clip Cable smart power systems and high-power module power supplies, compatible with today's 48V/12V ecosystem and built to support a future ±400V/800V high-voltage distribution transition; its range includes Power Shelf & Rectifier, 70A-1000A 54V Busbar Clip, up to 3200W 12V/54V AC/DC CRPS and Power Module/VRM/VPM. In thermal management it offers a 120kW liquid-to-liquid CDU, a 10U air-to-liquid CDU, a gravity-enhanced immersion oil-cooled cabinet and a liquid-cooled I/O cage dissipating 32W per port, plus cold-plate liquid cooling, manifolds and in-row and rack CDUs.
quarterly_data.figure: 120kW liquid-to-liquid CDU; liquid-cooled I/O cage 32W per port; ORV3 Busbar/Powershelf supporting future ±400V/800V

quarterly_data.signal: AI data-center product pipeline (annual report R&D table): APEX VH high-speed backplane connector and Intrepid apex vr cable backplane connector module (for customers' AI racks) are in small-batch trial production, targeting mass-production transfer and bulk customer delivery in Q3 2026; Nexus XH backplane connector module (224G AI racks) targets mass-production transfer and bulk delivery in Q2 2026; OminClip 224G chip-side NPC connector (128 GPU cards per rack) is at sample certification with mass production in Q3 & Q4 2026; Nearstack 2.0 Plug cable connector for an overseas customer's 18G project is at sample certification, mass production Q4 2026 & Q1 2027; OmniX to OSFP targets mass-production transfer in Q3 2026; OSFP224 2X1 high-speed external optical port (TH6 project) targets mass-production transfer in Q3 2026; the FP801 800G OSFP 2xFR4 optical module, developed for a well-known overseas cloud vendor's data center growth, is in small-batch trial, to move into production and generate sales in 2026; the DPA03 1.6T OSFP DR/FR optical module completed initial validation in Q4 2025 with revenue to build gradually in 2026; a 33KW high-power-density rack power supply is at sample certification with revenue to build gradually in 2026.
quarterly_data.figure: 224G backplane / NPC connectors and OSFP224 port target mass production Q2-Q4 2026; 1.6T optical module revenue from 2026

quarterly_data.signal: AI systems and cooling parts (annual report R&D table): an 8U rack compute server is in mass production - an 8U GPU server platform adapted with domestic switch-chip makers, integrating Intel EMR and AMD Turin compute modules and supporting up to 32 800Gb OSFP ports; a 2U ICN switch box is in mass production; a stainless-steel AI-rack cable box for the ETH-X supernode project is in mass production; liquid cold plates for next-generation and stacked optical modules are in small-batch trial, including a new liquid-cooled I/O cold plate system reaching 32W per I/O port that works with ASIC cold plates for full liquid cooling of high-bandwidth switches.
quarterly_data.figure: 8U GPU server (up to 32 800Gb OSFP ports) and 2U ICN switch box in mass production

quarterly_data.signal: R&D (annual report): R&D investment RMB 11.43 billion in 2025, up 33.57%, 3.44% of revenue (3.18% in 2024); RMB 90,951,325.42 (0.80%) capitalised, mainly ODM development from the enlarged consolidation scope; R&D staff 34,357 (+52.14%), 8.25% of employees. The company puts about 30% of R&D spend into frontier materials, process and manufacturing technology; cumulative R&D over the last three years RMB 281.73 hundred million; 9367 patents.

quarterly_data.signal: Outlook (annual report, company plan): the company says it will step up forward investment in 448G-and-above high-speed electrical connections, 1.6T and 3.2T-and-above high-speed optical connections, XPO ultra-high-density interconnect, high-performance thermal modules, integrated power modules and embodied-intelligence robot equipment. It says the data center business 'has become an important growth engine for the company'; it will follow the technology roadmaps of leading global cloud service providers (CSPs) and AI chip makers, consolidate its global lead in high-speed copper interconnect and accelerate optical interconnect, high-efficiency liquid cooling and high-power smart power for compute clusters. No numeric guidance.
